name: 47460-specdecode-qwen38b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 on an a3 node, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One card, one in-process engine, no sharding; the proposer inherits the target's TP and cannot be given its own.
architecture: Target Qwen/Qwen3-8B: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 36 layers, 32 query over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, vocab 151936, bf16, ~8.2B parameters (16.4 GB), KV 144 KiB/token. Proposer Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 28 layers, hidden 1024, tied embeddings, ~0.6B (1.2 GB). The two share one tokenizer, which the engine requires of a draft/target pair.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams 1, bounded at 320 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion (exactly one pass of the 80-prompt file), leaving 240 measured.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn, no prefix_buckets and no shared prefix: `configs/data/mtbench-firstturn-80x4.jsonl`, the first turn of all 80 MT-Bench questions (question_id 81-160, all eight categories), cycled 4 times to make the 320-request bound. Raw prompt tokens under the Qwen3 tokenizer are mean 68.0, min 12, p50 38, max 356; the backend renders each prompt into a user message and applies the model's chat template, which costs exactly 8 tokens on every row, giving wire lengths mean 76.0, min 20, max 364. Output is capped at 256 tokens and EOS is honoured (`ignore_eos: false`), so output length varies per prompt. Greedy: temperature 0.0, top_p 1.0.
purpose: A single-stream chat assistant answering short open-ended questions with an 8B model and small draft model on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM engine arguments for this item. Flat `key: value` only; everything not named here is the
# engine's own default. The engine is the commit de100ffb622f435b727177fc751c8de5f41c4d3b
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.23.1rc0-1157-gde100ffb622f4), not a release.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

# Speculative decoding with an ordinary small checkpoint as the proposer -- no trained EAGLE or
# Medusa head, so no auxiliary weights are needed. The pair MUST share a tokenizer (both vocab
# 151936); the engine refuses one whose vocab sizes differ. `max_model_len` is repeated inside
# the block because the proposer carries its own model config and does not inherit the target's.
# `disable_padded_drafter_batch` must NOT appear here: this engine raises NotImplementedError at
# construction if it is set, for draft models and parallel drafting alike.
speculative-config: {"method": "draft_model", "model": "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "max_model_len": 4096}

# The proposer inherits the target's tensor-parallel size, so this is not a free parameter: a
# sub-billion-parameter model sharded wider spends its step in collectives. 17.6 GB of weights
# fit one card in any case.
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The worst request here is 364 wire prompt tokens plus the 256-token cap = 620, so the window
# can never bind; it is written identically into the proposer above so the pair agrees.
max-model-len: 4096
